applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Jeremiah 22:30/C4 should count against the curse limb and concludes no live link remains, so it does not count the verse as an unanswered witness.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: 'counts as an unanswered witness' — I weighed reading C4 as counted against the dropped curse limb versus not counted because no live link remains; I read it as not counted.
why: By saying the defender dropped the curse limb and no live link remains, the judge does not count Jeremiah 22:30 as an unanswered witness, so its non-counting obeys K-G4.
